security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; worker-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Desktop environment for agent-assisted software development
bundle.longDescription: Ataraxia puts coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) in a keyboard-first workspace: chat, a code review ranked by what needs a look, decisions kept as threads, flow diagrams and a terminal.
